query:
When the family sorted contributions for the January gathering, everyone agreed to bring something. What did one person's initial response reveal about their actual relationship to the food-bringing expectation, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nkem
B. Emeka
C. Bisi
D. Kayode
context:

[2] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[3] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?

[5] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.

[8] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[9] (about=Bisi, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:41:00) omg yes SEUN's jollof 🙌🙌🙌 what do I bring
[10] (about=Emeka, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:56:00) Good rice is good rice. E.
[11] (about=Funke, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Funke confirms the gathering at her and Tolu's house on 25th January at 3pm, excited to use new dining chairs.
[12] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Auntie Grace advises Kayode to eat something proper before arriving.
[13] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem expresses desire to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas and asks if it is appropriate.
[14] (about=Nkem, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Nkem notes this is her first proper New Year message in the group chat and suggests it could be a good tradition to start.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Nkem suggests that sending a proper New Year message in the group chat could be a good tradition to start.
[16] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[17] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu states that restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes that Adaeze's adaptation of recipes for Seun is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[19] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
**D. Kayode**

Kayode’s initial response revealed that he didn’t initially treat the food-bringing expectation as applying to him in the same way: he apparently offered **drinks only**, not a dish. The specific evidence is Adaeze’s correction — **“Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?”** — and Funke’s compromise that **“Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff.”** That shows his original contribution was missing the food/dish element everyone else was expected to bring.

query:
The family had their regular Sunday video call. What did one family member's participation reveal about their actual relationship to the call — and what in Adaeze's account of the call makes that visible?

Options:
A. Kayode
B. Bisi
C. Emeka
D. Nkem
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:27:00) The call happened. Your father was on for a little while. He said he needed to rest. God willing he is fine.
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:27:00) Nkem you are right. My children, Kayode has worked very hard and we are all proud.
[4] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:54:00) Nkem you only had to ask. Come any Sunday, God willing.
[5] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t1 @2025-01-13T18:30:00) Adaeze proposes a family gathering on Saturday 25th January and asks to use Tolu and Funke's house because it is bigger.
[7] (about=Auntie Grace, said_by=Nkem, profile, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Nkem observes that the people in this family who give the most advice also tend to follow it the least, and Auntie Grace agrees.
[8] (about=Kayode, said_by=Tolu, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu notes that consistency is the only thing the family chat requires.
[9] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t12 @2025-02-17T20:02:00) The family agrees to invite Funke's parents to Christmas this year.
[11] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Uncle Dele greets each family member individually, wishing them industry and good health for the year.
agent_answer:
**A. Kayode**

Kayode’s participation revealed that he had been **consistently present on the calls** — he was on every call that month. Adaeze’s account makes this visible when she says:

> “Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.”
